#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

APP="$CM_BUILD_DIR/engine/Debug/wf_game.app"
BUNDLE_ID="org.worldfoundry.wf-game"
SCREENSHOT="$CM_BUILD_DIR/sim-screenshot.png"
SIMLOG="$CM_BUILD_DIR/sim-launch.log"

# Pick the first available iPhone simulator that matches the SDK.
DEVICE_ID=$(xcrun simctl list -j devices available \
  | python3 -c '
import json, sys
j = json.load(sys.stdin)["devices"]
for runtime, devs in j.items():
    if "iOS" not in runtime: continue
    for d in devs:
        if "iPhone" in d["name"] and d["isAvailable"]:
            print(d["udid"]); sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
')
echo "Using simulator UDID: $DEVICE_ID"

xcrun simctl boot "$DEVICE_ID" || true   # already-booted is fine
xcrun simctl bootstatus "$DEVICE_ID" -b

echo "--- install ---"
xcrun simctl install "$DEVICE_ID" "$APP"

echo "--- launch (background, console-pty detached) ---"
# --terminate-running-process so reruns don't share state.
# --console-pty would block; we redirect the launched process's
# stderr/stdout via the unified log stream instead.
xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process "$DEVICE_ID" "$BUNDLE_ID"

echo "--- wait for viewDidLoad log ---"
# Stream the unified log for 3 seconds to catch the NSLog from
# WFRootViewController::viewDidLoad (cd.iff sanity probe).
timeout 3 xcrun simctl spawn "$DEVICE_ID" log stream \
    --level debug \
    --predicate "processImagePath CONTAINS 'wf_game'" \
  > "$SIMLOG" 2>&1 || true
echo "--- last 40 lines of sim log ---"
tail -40 "$SIMLOG" || true

echo "--- screenshot ---"
xcrun simctl io "$DEVICE_ID" screenshot "$SCREENSHOT"
ls -la "$SCREENSHOT" "$SIMLOG"

echo "--- shutdown ---"
xcrun simctl shutdown "$DEVICE_ID" || true

# Non-fatal — the sanity probe is informational. Build is still
# green if simctl succeeded to install + launch + screenshot.
if grep -q "cd.iff opened" "$SIMLOG"; then
    echo "Phase 1 Verify: HALGetAssetAccessor opened cd.iff"
else
    echo "WARN: did not observe 'cd.iff opened' in sim log — check screenshot + log"
fi
